prompts.empire-hostile:
LIVE: the Empire is hostile and raiding.
1. game_pause_game first, then game_list_colonists.
2. game_set_draft every armed shooter; order_pawn them into the embrasure room between base and enemy.
3. Ranged first, fall back while firing so melee never closes.
4. Shielded cataphracts: EMP grenades if count_weapon_grenadeemp>0, else focus fire one at a time.
5. Order refused: re-issue to the next embrasure cell; still refused -> everyone behind turrets.
6. Done = hostiles_on_map 0 -> ladder_set mark empire_raid_survived true, undraft.
prompts.title-track:
LIVE: a colonist's title changed.
1. ladder: read title_seniority.
2. Map it with TITLE_RANK_TABLE (100 Freeholder=1 ... 700 Count=7).
3. ladder_set mark title_rank <n>; ladder_set mark psylink_level <n>.
Done = both marks match the title.
prompts.empire-quest:
LIVE: a new Empire quest letter.
1. game_list_letters -> game_open_letter.
2. Honor in the reward AND fight_ratio>=QUEST_MIN_FIGHT_RATIO -> accept; else dismiss.
3. Quest pawn = nearest the next title, never the only doctor.
4. Accept refused: game_get_ui_layout, click Accept by name; still nothing -> game_dismiss_letter.
5. Done = ladder_set mark empire_quest_active true.
prompts.bestowing:
LIVE: bestowing ceremony.
1. game_open_letter; note where the bestower lands.
2. hostile_threat true -> defend first.
3. order_pawn the titled pawn beside the bestower; hold until done.
4. Refused: order_pawn to the adjacent cell.
5. Done = ladder_set mark title_rank <n> and psylink_level <n>.
prompts.throne-base-plan:
LIVE: plan the mountain base around the throne (one time).
1. game_select_architect_designator Plan; game_drag_cell each room.
2. Door -> throne room on the 3-wide spine; right hall = prison, left hall = guests, separate.
3. Labs/tech deeper; dissection behind embrasure halls; altar left of the throne.
4. Generators + batteries in their own area. Fields in the SE cut-outs.
5. Designator refused: game_list_architect_categories -> Orders -> Plan, retry.
Done = ladder_set mark throne_plan_done true.
Owner: "main room ienter is the throne room centered on spine labs and tech stuff deepeer in with insta right and left halls to prison and guests seperate"
